task_instance: Ran the full autoresearch loop (setup params self-decided since no interactive user was present, branch+baseline, iterative experiment loop, reporting) on a small git repo containing a naive O(n*sqrt(n)) prime-counting function (solution.py) with a benchmark script (bench.py, metric = wall-clock time of count_primes(20000), lower is better) and a pytest test file (test_solution.py) marked out-of-scope. Goal: reduce execution time while keeping tests passing and solution.py as the only in-scope file.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/github__awesome-copilot__autoresearch.
